definitions.explanation: To physically catch or stop something coming toward you.
To mentally receive and process information, criticism, or feelings.

examples.japanese: ボールを{受|う}け{止|と}める。
{批判|ひはん}を{真剣|しんけん}に{受|う}け{止|と}める。
{彼|かれ}の{気持|きも}ちを{受|う}け{止|と}めてあげて。

notes:
{受|う}け{止|と}める means to catch/stop something physically or to accept/process something mentally.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle for the object

COMPOUND VERB:
Formed from {受|う}ける (to receive) + {止|と}める (to stop).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ボールを{受|う}け{止|と}める: to catch a ball
- {批判|ひはん}を{受|う}け{止|と}める: to take criticism to heart
- {現実|げんじつ}を{受|う}け{止|と}める: to accept reality
- {真剣|しんけん}に{受|う}け{止|と}める: to take seriously

ASPECT (ている):
{受|う}け{止|と}めている indicates an ongoing state of acceptance or understanding.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受|う}け{取|と}る: to receive, to interpret
- {受|う}け{入|い}れる: to accept, to take in
